VISIBLE_DEFECT_FROM_CURRENT_SCREENSHOT:
- SUPRA universe selected while central content still presents SUPRA CHAT / Command workspace.
- This violates surface ownership: SUPRA owns command; Chat owns conversation.

REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR:
- SUPRA = primary executive work/command surface
- Chat = conversation workspace only
- ojO = private authority/context/human-gate surface
- Runtime = read-only observability
- Missions = bounded execution
- Control = decisions/proof/authority
- CAnnoNico = memory/provenance/canonical truth
- Terminal = recovery/diagnostic only
- Physical host canonical name = MacBook; legacy iMac means MacBook only

DO NOW, SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Wait for the current canonical CI head containing the coherence changes to succeed. Do not install a failing head.
2) Run COHERENCE_GATE against that exact source and require COHERENCE_SCORE>=0.95.
3) Build Release from that exact canonical source using the existing proven path.
4) Preserve rollback and install only to CANONICAL_APP.
5) Launch exactly one SUPRA instance; no open -n.
6) Prove the default visible universe is SUPRA and the main content is the SUPRA executive surface, not Chat.
7) Prove Chat displays "Conversation workspace", not "Command workspace".
8) Prove ojO displays "Private authority surface."
9) Prove placeholder quick actions Evidence Explorer / Capability Browser are not exposed as working actions.
10) Prove runtime health still uses the existing bridge/runtime and no new engine/bridge/runtime was created.
11) Run a bounded smoke test from SUPRA: issue a harmless read-only prompt through the existing SUPRAChatRuntimeAdapter and require non-empty response.
12) If any coherence invariant fails, repair only the smallest existing view/routing/status defect, rerun build + coherence gate, and stop after bounded success/failure.
13) Return proof automatically. Do not ask Nicolas to copy/paste Terminal commands.
